description:
Hushfeed v0.47.0 targets global TikTok 47.0.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

Hushfeed settings now opens with a live status card showing the installed Hushfeed and TikTok versions. Diagnostics, Feed filter, Privacy and Screen time are directly available beside Search. The new controls expose native button roles, visible focus and press feedback, and large text layouts that stack instead of clipping.

Validation: 1444 runtime tests passed locally, plus 243 patch tests. Both Android lint checks passed. The bundle carries 91 patches and all three nonempty DEX payloads. Every patch applied with zero failures to TikTok 47.0.3 and the retained 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures, with no manifest changes. The dedicated S22 pass preserved the signed-in account, verified all four new routes and restored the phone's display settings. Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.
